initial_addon: This is a non-scoring executor-capability probe. Do not answer the English A/B/C question. Write a complete labelled formalization. Its first executable declaration MUST be top-level domain(person,[...]). Then encode every source sentence exactly once as axiom(sN, Surface), with its exact English in a preceding SWI-Prolog comment (%). An atomic fact such as ‘Selah has wings’ MUST be axiom(sN, has_wings(selah)). Never encode a fact as rule([P],P): that is a self-supporting cycle, not a fact, and the proof tree will reject it. A Horn implication uses axiom(sN, rule([Premise,...], Conclusion)). Preserve non-Horn not/or/xor/and sentences visibly under their source labels, but do not force them into Horn rules. Do not duplicate an s-ID. The source sentence whose Horn conclusion is {{goal}} MUST be a rule(..., {{goal}}). Query exactly audit_proof_tree({{goal}}, Result), with no ?- and no trailing period. Return JSON only: {"program":"...","query":"..."}.
repair_instruction: The executor rejected the Horn proof probe. Preserve the world, source labels, and query. A source fact must be axiom(sN, predicate(...)), never rule([P],P); every label occurs once. Keep domain(person,[...]). top-level. Return JSON only: {"program":"...","query":"..."}.
